storyline.real: Schumacher wins from 16th on the grid, staying out on slicks in the rain; Hill, from eighth, finishes second after a stop-go for pit-lane speeding

mastery.label: Win on two stops or fewer, as Schumacher did

hidden.label: Win by more than nine seconds

eras.briefing: Spa, 1995. A wet-dry qualifying left Schumacher 16th and Hill eighth, and the rain comes and goes. Schumacher leads the championship, 56 points to Hill's 45. Slicks, inters or wets: every lap it's your call. Reconstructed race: no lap timing survives, so the laps are rebuilt to fit the result, the fastest laps, the sourced stops and who led each lap (Jolpica, F1DB, Motor Sport, Wikipedia). Who led each lap is sourced; the lap times, and the order behind the leader, are reconstructed.

storylineCalls.real: Hill pits for wets at the end of lap 21 as the drizzle becomes rain
His wets tail off as the rain stops on lap 25, and Hill pits again for slicks at the end of lap 26
Hill goes back onto wets at the end of lap 30, in the safety car, as Schumacher does
Hill serves a stop-go for speeding in the pit lane at the end of lap 33 and finishes second, 19.5 s behind
